title: PlayerCore: Progression
summary: Turn simple travel commands into reliable base, route, and server recovery habits.

blocks.title: Early Routes
blocks.body: Start with one home, one known path to spawn, and one safe return habit. Avoid naming too many homes before you understand the server limit.

blocks.title: Midgame Network
blocks.body: As bases and teams spread out, use named homes, warps, and TPA to reduce dead travel while keeping important locations readable.

blocks.title: Server Maturity
blocks.body: On mature servers, travel rules become part of the economy and safety plan. Expect admins to tune limits, cooldowns, and permission levels over time.

blocks.title: Upgrade Check
blocks.body: Do not raise the risk until the current upgrade tier works without emergency improvising.
